name: lily-companion
description: Local HTTP bridge so Lily can read and edit the active VS Code file by voice.

lilyCompanion.port.description: Localhost port the companion listens on.

lilyCompanion.token.description: Optional shared secret. If set, callers must send it as a Bearer token.

lilyCompanion.allowOutsideWorkspace.description: Allow edits and file creation outside the open workspace folders.
